verdict.rationale: Linear documents a first-party GraphQL API with personal API keys for scripts and an SDK usable in any JavaScript environment, giving it a non-UI interface for automation. A community user reports their CI moving issues from staged to deployed through the API and webhooks. However, there is no documented CLI, CI action, or dedicated headless/CI mode, so CI use depends on writing your own scripts against the API. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g., a GitHub Action), first-party docs on running Linear automation in CI pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: For personal scripts API keys are the easiest way to access the API.
It’s written in Typescript but can also be used in any Javascript environment.
Their CI moves issues from staged to deployed and pushes associated HubSpot tickets to a customer success queue.
